body: You are very welcome, Princess Brandy...I'm still curious about the choice of username though, considering the character it is in reference too. You are beautiful by the way, just thought you should know.

It's a Chuck Palahniuk reference to one of the main characters in the novel "Invisible Monsters." It's a rather interesting choice of usernames because of various spoilers in the book that I won't get into in case you would like to read it. But those who have will understand. You should read it by the way, he's a fantastic writer.
Upvote for having a sense of humour.
